heading: Termination of effectiveness
lead: The authority provided by this subchapter terminates effective October 1, 2023.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–334 amended section generally. Prior to amendment, text read as follows: “There are authorized to be appropriated such sums as are necessary to carry out this subchapter for each of fiscal years 2004 through 2008.”
